posts.name: Ronway
posts.cooked: Nu, who was getting tired of his life on Nu, decided he would sneak aboard Zeerflonx's ship while no one was looking.
posts.raw: Nu, who was getting tired of his life on Nu, decided he would sneak aboard Zeerflonx's ship while no one was looking.

posts.cooked: The good news was Zeerflonx seemed to have come alone
posts.raw: The good news was Zeerflonx seemed to have come alone

posts.name: Envisioner
posts.cooked: The bad news was that Zeerflonx was paranoid about having his wares plundered, and had booby-trapped his ship from stem to stern.
posts.raw: The bad news was that Zeerflonx was paranoid about having his wares plundered, and had booby-trapped his ship from stem to stern.

posts.name: Ronway
posts.cooked: The booby-traps were rendered useless upon contact of Nu's rock hard chest.
posts.raw: The booby-traps were rendered useless upon contact of Nu's rock hard chest.

posts.name: phantaskippy

posts.name: Nielzabub
posts.cooked: After crushing the chest hard rocks with his literal knees of stell, Nu found a collection of valuable vintage Nubian porn, however, he had no means of carrying such a heavy load.
posts.raw: After crushing the chest hard rocks with his literal knees of stell, Nu found a collection of valuable vintage Nubian porn, however, he had no means of carrying such a heavy load.

posts.name: Envisioner
posts.cooked: In attempting to rig a magnetic contraption to lift the chest, he unwittingly erased the ancient erotic recordings; upon realizing his mistake, he reasoned that the Universal Church of No Fun (which for obvious reasons maintained a highly profitable franchise on Nu) would pay him handsomely for his destruction of "unsanitary ideological matter".

posts.name: jagarciao
posts.cooked: There was only one problem... no one knew how to contact the Church... no one ever had to before. The Church would usually contact you when you were having too much fun. It was never the other way around.

posts.name: Nielzabub
posts.cooked: He would have to do something incredibly fun and sinful to get their attention.
posts.raw: He would have to do something incredibly fun and sinful to get their attention.

posts.name: Envisioner
posts.cooked: Since the Nuvian idea of incredible, sinful fun consisted of playing a game where you catch a ball on a string in a cup tied to the string, Nu made a point of being seen doing exactly that in multiple Church-controlled districts of the planet's capital city of E-Pappa-Loopa-Shooby-Doobah-Doo-Dah-Too.

posts.name: Envisioner
posts.cooked: The Jolly Green Giant informed Nu (and about half of Nu, since it is very small and has an atmosphere highly conducive to sound travel) that this story had become entirely too corny, and then stepped back through the fourth wall and slammed it behind him.

posts.name: Nielzabub
posts.cooked: With no gian leg to protect him now, Nu held out a deck of cards and hoped that believing in the heart of the cards would help him.
posts.raw: With no gian leg to protect him now, Nu held out a deck of cards and hoped that believing in the heart of the cards would help him.

posts.name: Envisioner
posts.cooked: Unfortunately the heart of the cards had chosen that particular afternoon to undergo a triple-bypass operation, and so Nu was quickly hauled off to the Juvenile Incorrectional Facility on Peaty Grime (despite not actually being a juvenile; the reason for this was explained, but on the advice of his lawyer he was not paying attention at the time...he would later reflect that he had not had an especially good lawyer).
